Help & Operations
Merchant Guidelines & Operations FAQ
5 Points
1. How do I update shop inventory & daily stocks?
Regularly update your item availability and quantities in the "Inventory" tab. When fresh dairy, produce, or packaged groceries arrive each morning, toggle them "IN STOCK" so village customers can place instant orders.
2. What are the packaging guidelines for safe rural transit?
Always double-bag liquid items like milk pouches, mustard oil bottles, and ghee jars. Use sturdy paper or cloth bags for heavy grains, pulses, and flours to avoid tearing or spillage over unpaved village roads.
3. How should I manage out-of-stock items during rush hours?
If any item sells out in your physical store, immediately toggle its status to "OUT OF STOCK" in the Dukaan app. This prevents unfulfillable customer orders, avoids cancellation penalties, and protects your merchant rating.
4. What is the weekly bank settlement schedule?
All fulfilled order earnings are automatically processed and transferred directly to your Penny Drop verified bank account every Tuesday and Friday night through automated NEFT/IMPS clearinghouse with 0% platform commission.
5. Why is my earning slightly less on online orders?
For online payments, backend processors like Razorpay deduct a standard percentage fee to process and transfer the money to your bank account. Cash on Delivery (COD) orders do not have this online fee, so you get the full amount.

Terms & Hyperlocal Policies

1. Zero Platform Commission: Under the GaonBazaar Rural Growth Initiative, 0% platform commission applies on all genuine grocery orders.

2. 8km Geofenced Service: Orders are routed exclusively to shops located within 8km radius of village customers to assure 20-30 min delivery.

3. Settlement & Payouts: Daily UPI / IMPS payouts with automated ₹1 penny drop beneficiary verification.
